_comment: The events catalogue that ships with the client, and the floor the tab
falls back to when the published manifest cannot be read.
It is deliberately almost empty. Everything on this calendar that the
client can work out for itself already comes from somewhere else:
tournaments from the tournament service, released patches from the
changelog index. What belongs here is what only a person knows, and this
file cannot know it: a game night's weekday, a CGN date, a meetup. Those
belong in the published document, where adding one is a commit rather than
a client release. See docs/events-catalogue.md for the format.
The one entry below is the exception the design of this feature named: a
recurrence rule needs no source, because the rule is the fact.
No submitUrl here on purpose: this copy is used when the published
document could not be read, so a button into that document's repository
is the one thing that cannot be relied on. See seed_catalogue().

events.title: Ladder map pool rotation
events.summary: The 1v1 ladder pool changes at the start of the month. Which maps come in is announced when it happens.
